message.content:
Here’s the simplest way to get exactly two parts:

```python
temp = "hello=good="
parts = temp.split('=', 1)   # split at most once
print(parts)                # ['hello', 'good=']
```

`str.split(sep, maxsplit)` lets you specify how many splits to perform. By passing `maxsplit=1`, the string is split only at the first `"="`, leaving the rest of the string (including any trailing `"="`) intact.
